cases.name: contains
cases.description: verify-release-ancestry.test.mjs: accepts a release the deploy branch contains.

cases.name: never-received
cases.description: verify-release-ancestry.test.mjs: refuses a release the deploy branch never received.
cases.stderr:
Refusing to deploy: the deploy branch does not contain this release.

  release commit : {offBranch}
  deploy branch  : {onBranch:short} (HEAD)

The image would be the one this release built, but the deployment instructions would come from an
older branch state. Anything the release added to the deployment contract - a new BG_COMPOSE_ENV
entry, a new Compose variable, a changed migration step - would be silently dropped, and the run
would still report success.

Promote the release commit to the deploy branch first, then run this deployment again.

cases.name: abbreviated

cases.stderr: Release provenance '{onBranch:8}' is not a full commit id; refusing to guess which commit it means.

cases.name: directory
cases.description: A directory where the provenance file should be is not a regular file.
cases.stderr: Release provenance file '.pipeline-artifacts/source-commit' is missing; cannot prove the deploy branch carries this release.

cases.name: missing-file
cases.description: verify-release-ancestry.test.mjs: refuses a missing provenance file.
cases.stderr: Release provenance file '.pipeline-artifacts/source-commit' is missing; cannot prove the deploy branch carries this release.

cases.name: empty-file
cases.description: verify-release-ancestry.test.mjs: refuses an empty provenance file.
cases.stderr: Release provenance '' is not a full commit id; refusing to guess which commit it means.

cases.name: not-hex
cases.description: verify-release-ancestry.test.mjs: refuses a provenance file that is not a commit id.
cases.stderr: Release provenance file '.pipeline-artifacts/source-commit' does not hold a commit id.

cases.name: unknown-commit
cases.description: verify-release-ancestry.test.mjs: refuses a commit this checkout has never heard of.
cases.stderr:
Release commit aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa is unknown to this checkout, so the deploy branch cannot be shown to contain it.
Deepen the deploy checkout (AETHEUS_GIT_HISTORY_DEPTH) or confirm the release was published to this remote.

cases.name: blanks-removed
cases.description: Spaces, tabs, CR and LF anywhere in the file are removed before the checks.

cases.name: uppercase
cases.description: An uppercase full id is accepted as hexadecimal.

cases.name: unknown-64
cases.description: A 64-character id unknown to a SHA-1 repository.
cases.stderr:
Release commit bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb is unknown to this checkout, so the deploy branch cannot be shown to contain it.
Deepen the deploy checkout (AETHEUS_GIT_HISTORY_DEPTH) or confirm the release was published to this remote.

cases.name: length-39
cases.description: A 39-character id is not a full commit id.
cases.stderr: Release provenance '{onBranch:0:39}' is not a full commit id; refusing to guess which commit it means.

cases.name: length-41
cases.description: A 41-character id is not a full commit id.
cases.stderr: Release provenance '{onBranch}a' is not a full commit id; refusing to guess which commit it means.

cases.name: vertical-tab
cases.description: A vertical tab is not removed, so the id is not hexadecimal.
cases.stderr: Release provenance file '.pipeline-artifacts/source-commit' does not hold a commit id.

cases.name: deploy-ref
cases.description: The deploy ref names another branch, which contains the release.

cases.name: deploy-ref-unknown
cases.description: The deploy ref does not resolve: git rev-parse fails under set -e.

cases.name: shallow-deepened
cases.description: A shallow clone is unshallowed from origin, then shown to contain an older release.

cases.name: shallow-unprovable
cases.description: A shallow clone whose origin is gone holds the release as a graft: still shallow, cannot decide.
cases.stderr:
Release commit {s1} is not reachable from {c3:short}, but this checkout is still shallow,
so the deploy branch cannot be shown either to contain or to lack it. Deepen the checkout and retry.

cases.name: shallow-unknown
cases.description: A shallow clone whose origin is gone lacks the older release entirely.
cases.stderr:

Deepen the deploy checkout (AETHEUS_GIT_HISTORY_DEPTH) or confirm the release was published to this remote.

cases.name: shallow-head
cases.description: A shallow clone whose origin is gone: HEAD itself is its own ancestor.
